title: Cartoon time
text: Bobby, Tina and their parents go to see Grandpa in the afternoon.
Happy Double Ninth Festival, Grandpa! We love you!
Thank you! I love you too!
My birthday is next Monday. I can't wait!
What do Bobby and Tina do to make their grandpa happy?
